answer: Keep identity weight tied to a publication record. Each identity keeps its own island archive and must publish one original artifact per epoch — an analysis or dataset — extending its previous artifact, so a bought or copied piece breaks the chain. Two randomly drawn reviewers from the oasis pool, each capped at three reviews per epoch, must approve it; each approval earns 10 nectar, a non-transferable credit. Ten thousand clones would need 20,000 review slots per epoch against a pool capped at 6,000; slots are drawn by lottery and cannot be purchased, so no farm can outbid the queue.
